# Generated by mods/where_to_produce/tools/generate.py. Do not edit by hand.
#
# The right the search answers for, and which rights this country is offered.
#
# **This was two CMM lists and their tick-parsing until 2026-09-06.** Both are
# gone with the mod page's «Товар» tab: a right is picked in the ranking window
# now, on a cell that knows its own number, exactly as a good is. What survived
# the move is the one thing the lists did that a cell cannot -- deciding whether
# this country may be shown a unique right at all -- and it is a variable per
# right now, because a window can read a variable and cannot ask a trigger.

# Scope: country

	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_rsel1
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_rsel2
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_rsel3
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_rsel4
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_rsel5
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_rsel6
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_rsel7
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_rsel8
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_rsel9
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_rsel10
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_rsel11
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_rsel12
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_rsel13
}

# constantinopolitan_silk_monopoly_rights
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_set_right_1 = {
	bag_wtp_clear_good_sel = yes
	bag_wtp_clear_right_sel = yes
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_index value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_index value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rsel1 value = 1 }

	# A good and a right are two answers to one question.
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 0 }

	bag_wtp_clear_rows = yes
}

# The right's circle from the stored answer, for the first load after the cells
# replaced the lists. Called by `bag_wtp_sync_sel`, which clears both blocks
# first, so this only ever writes the one that is chosen.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_sync_right_sel = {
	if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rsel1 value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 2 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rsel2 value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 3 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rsel3 value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 4 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rsel4 value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 5 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rsel5 value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 6 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rsel6 value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 7 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rsel7 value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 8 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rsel8 value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 9 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rsel9 value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 10 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rsel10 value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 11 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rsel11 value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 12 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rsel12 value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 13 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rsel13 value = 1 } }
}

# What this country is offered, as one variable a cell can read.
#
# The nine general ones stay whatever the age: they are everybody's, one advance
# away, and this mod is for planning ahead -- hiding them until age three would
# leave a gap where the answer belongs. **A unique right is another matter.**
# Wallachia has no business being shown Constantinople's silk monopoly, and the
# game already says so: the monopoly carries
# `potential = { OR = { has_or_had_tag = BYZ has_or_had_tag = ROM } }`. That
# is asked here, and it is not this mod's opinion about who owns what.
#
# **A `visible` in a window cannot call a scripted trigger**, which is why this
# is an effect leaving a flag rather than a trigger the cell asks. It runs on
# the registration hook, which fires on load and again every time the mod page
# is opened.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_refresh_rights = {
	if = {
		limit = { AND = { OR = { has_or_had_tag = BYZ has_or_had_tag = ROM } } }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_ok1 value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_ok1
		# A right that is no longer offered is no longer the answer either.
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 1 }
			bag_wtp_drop_right = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { AND = { culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:netherlandish_group } } }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_ok2 value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_ok2
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 2 }
			bag_wtp_drop_right = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = yes }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_ok3 value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_ok3
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 3 }
			bag_wtp_drop_right = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = yes }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_ok4 value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_ok4
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 4 }
			bag_wtp_drop_right = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = yes }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_ok5 value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_ok5
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 5 }
			bag_wtp_drop_right = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = yes }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_ok6 value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_ok6
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 6 }
			bag_wtp_drop_right = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = yes }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_ok7 value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_ok7
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 7 }
			bag_wtp_drop_right = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = yes }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_ok8 value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_ok8
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 8 }
			bag_wtp_drop_right = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { AND = { NOT = { culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:netherlandish_group } } } }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_ok9 value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_ok9
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 9 }
			bag_wtp_drop_right = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = yes }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_ok10 value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_ok10
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 10 }
			bag_wtp_drop_right = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = yes }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_ok11 value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_ok11
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 11 }
			bag_wtp_drop_right = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { AND = { culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:scandinavian_group } } }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_ok12 value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_ok12
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 12 }
			bag_wtp_drop_right = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { AND = { culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:scandinavian_group } } }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_ok13 value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_ok13
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 13 }
			bag_wtp_drop_right = yes
		}
	}
	# Места пересобираются целиком: грамота, которую держава потеряла,
	# не должна оставить за собой дыру.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot1 value = 0 }
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_rslotok1
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot2 value = 0 }
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_rslotok2
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot3 value = 0 }
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_rslotok3
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot4 value = 0 }
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_rslotok4
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot5 value = 0 }
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_rslotok5
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot6 value = 0 }
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_rslotok6
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot7 value = 0 }
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_rslotok7
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot8 value = 0 }
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_rslotok8
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot9 value = 0 }
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_rslotok9
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot10 value = 0 }
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_rslotok10
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot11 value = 0 }
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_rslotok11
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot12 value = 0 }
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_rslotok12
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot13 value = 0 }
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_rslotok13
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotn value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_right_ok1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotn add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot1 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok1 value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 2 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot2 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok2 value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 3 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot3 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok3 value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 4 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot4 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok4 value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 5 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot5 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok5 value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 6 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot6 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok6 value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 7 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot7 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok7 value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 8 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot8 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok8 value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 9 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot9 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok9 value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 10 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot10 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok10 value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 11 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot11 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok11 value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 12 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot12 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok12 value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 13 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot13 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok13 value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_right_ok2 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotn add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot1 value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok1 value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 2 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot2 value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok2 value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 3 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot3 value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok3 value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 4 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot4 value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok4 value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 5 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot5 value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok5 value = 1 }

		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslotn = 6 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot6 value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok6 value = 1 }

			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok7 value = 1 }

		if = {

			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok8 value = 1 }
		}
		if = {

			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok9 value = 1 }

			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslot10 value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rslotok10 value = 1 }

# Score every candidate for the ticked right.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_score_right = {
	if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 1 } bag_wtp_score_right_1 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 2 } bag_wtp_score_right_2 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 3 } bag_wtp_score_right_3 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 4 } bag_wtp_score_right_4 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 5 } bag_wtp_score_right_5 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 6 } bag_wtp_score_right_6 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 7 } bag_wtp_score_right_7 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 8 } bag_wtp_score_right_8 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 9 } bag_wtp_score_right_9 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 10 } bag_wtp_score_right_10 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 11 } bag_wtp_score_right_11 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 12 } bag_wtp_score_right_12 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 13 } bag_wtp_score_right_13 = yes }
}

# constantinopolitan_silk_monopoly_rights -- cloth +25%, fine_cloth +10%, silk +50%
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_score_right_1 = {
	save_scope_as = bag_wtp_country
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_total value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_total value = 0 }
		# **Чем этот поиск сортирует -- то же, чем красит карта.** Его слово,
		# 2026-09-14: «функция поиска по одному городскому праву… я ожидаю, что
		# она будет тоже ориентироваться по аналогии карты городских прав».
		# `_rq<k>` и есть тот счёт. Кладём его на кандидата здесь, внутри обхода,
		# который и так идёт: `_r_score` считается в скоупе локации, а номер
		# отмеченной грамоты живёт на державе, и дотянуться туда оттуда нечем.
		# Покрытие считается здесь же, до того как его прочтёт `_rq<k>`:
		# доля входа требует триггера по провинции, то есть эффекта.
		bag_wtp_cov_pass = yes
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_fit value = bag_wtp_rq1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_3 value = 0 }
	}

	# cloth: price 3 x (1 + 0.25)
	bag_wtp_score_29 = yes
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **A right obeys the same two buttons as a good.** «Считать» reads the
		# answer available today, «На конец» the one that survives every advance.
		# The twenty-second run pressed the second and got the first, because this
		# read `_best_method` and nothing else.
		#
		# The fallbacks are the same too: a slot the ground feeds nothing keeps its
		# building and its icon and says 0.00%, and `_val` stays 0, so it is worth
		# nothing to the ranking and a row of nothing but those still goes.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_rank_by_end } }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best_method }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_best }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best_method_rural }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_any_best_method }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_any_best_method_rural }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_end_best }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method_rural }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_any_best_method }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_any_best_method_rural }
			}
		}
		# And the road there, summed the same way. It only ever breaks a tie, and
		# the ties it breaks are the ones «На конец» leaves: where nothing that
		# survives can be fed, every province in the table is worth exactly zero.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_1 value = var:bag_wtp_mid_best }
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_mid_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_mid_best }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_1 value = var:bag_wtp_mid_best_rural }
		}
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_1 multiply = 0.3750 }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_total add = var:bag_wtp_r_mid_1 }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 multiply = 0.3750 }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_total add = var:bag_wtp_r_val_1 }
	}

	# fine_cloth: price 6 x (1 + 0.1)
	bag_wtp_score_30 = yes
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_rank_by_end } }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_best_method }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_2 value = var:bag_wtp_best }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_best }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_best_method_rural }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_2 value = var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_2 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_any_best_method }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_2 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_any_best_method_rural }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_2 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_end_best }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method_rural }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_2 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_2 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_end_any_best_method }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_2 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_end_any_best_method_rural }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_2 value = var:bag_wtp_mid_best }
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_mid_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_mid_best }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_2 value = var:bag_wtp_mid_best_rural }
		}
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_2 multiply = 0.6600 }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_total add = var:bag_wtp_r_mid_2 }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_2 multiply = 0.6600 }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_total add = var:bag_wtp_r_val_2 }
	}

	# silk: price 4 x (1 + 0.5)
	bag_wtp_score_18 = yes
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_rank_by_end } }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_3 value = var:bag_wtp_best_method }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_3 value = var:bag_wtp_best }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_best }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_3 value = var:bag_wtp_best_method_rural }

# One method, read out of `bag_wtp_w_method` into scratch. A dispatch over every
# method in the game is too wide to run per candidate, so it runs only for the
# provinces that took a row -- fifty of them, three slots each.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_store_scratch = {
	clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_w_goods
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_w_bt
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_w_pm
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_bonus value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_out value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_w_method = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_bt value = building_type:beer_workshop }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_pm value = production_method:bavarian_beer_workshop_maintenance }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_bonus value = bag_wtp_b1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_out value = 1.3000 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods_all value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { province_definition = { any_location_in_province_definition = { raw_material = goods:lumber } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods target = goods:lumber }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { province_definition = { any_location_in_province_definition = { raw_material = goods:wheat } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods target = goods:wheat }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_w_method = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_bt value = building_type:beer_workshop }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_pm value = production_method:fruit_beer_workshop_maintenance }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_bonus value = bag_wtp_b2 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_out value = 1.1000 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods_all value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { province_definition = { any_location_in_province_definition = { raw_material = goods:fruit } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods target = goods:fruit }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { province_definition = { any_location_in_province_definition = { raw_material = goods:lumber } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods target = goods:lumber }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_w_method = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_bt value = building_type:beer_workshop }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_pm value = production_method:honey_beer_workshop_maintenance }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_bonus value = bag_wtp_b3 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_out value = 1.1000 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods_all value = 3 }
		if = {
			limit = { province_definition = { any_location_in_province_definition = { raw_material = goods:beeswax } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods target = goods:beeswax }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { province_definition = { any_location_in_province_definition = { raw_material = goods:lumber } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods target = goods:lumber }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { province_definition = { any_location_in_province_definition = { raw_material = goods:millet } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods target = goods:millet }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_w_method = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_bt value = building_type:beer_workshop }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_pm value = production_method:maize_beer_workshop_maintenance }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_bonus value = bag_wtp_b4 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_out value = 1.1000 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods_all value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { province_definition = { any_location_in_province_definition = { raw_material = goods:maize } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods target = goods:maize }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_w_method = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_bt value = building_type:beer_workshop }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_pm value = production_method:millet_beer_workshop_maintenance }

		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_out value = 2.0000 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods_all value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { province_definition = { any_location_in_province_definition = { raw_material = goods:lumber } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods target = goods:lumber }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { province_definition = { any_location_in_province_definition = { raw_material = goods:rice } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods target = goods:rice }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_w_method = 665 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_bt value = building_type:nd_cel_clachan }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_pm value = production_method:nd_cel_communal_farming }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_bonus value = bag_wtp_b665 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_out value = 0.1440 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods_all value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { province_definition = { any_location_in_province_definition = { raw_material = goods:livestock } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods target = goods:livestock }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_w_method = 666 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_bt value = building_type:nd_rmn_stana }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_pm value = production_method:nd_rmn_pastoral_operations }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_bonus value = bag_wtp_b666 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_out value = 0.1440 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods_all value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { province_definition = { any_location_in_province_definition = { raw_material = goods:livestock } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods target = goods:livestock }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_w_method = 667 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_bt value = building_type:sheep_farms }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_pm value = production_method:sheep_farm_maintenance }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_bonus value = bag_wtp_b667 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_out value = 0.5000 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods_all value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { province_definition = { any_location_in_province_definition = { raw_material = goods:lumber } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_w_goods target = goods:lumber }
		}
	}
}

# Scratch into slot 1.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_slot_1_from_scratch = {
	clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_r_goods_1
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_bt_1
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_pm_1
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_bonus_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_out_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_goods_all_1 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_w_bt }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_bt_1 value = var:bag_wtp_w_bt }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_pm_1 value = var:bag_wtp_w_pm }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_bonus_1 value = var:bag_wtp_w_bonus }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_out_1 value = var:bag_wtp_w_out }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_goods_all_1 value = var:bag_wtp_w_goods_all }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_w_goods
			prev = { add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_r_goods_1 target = prev } }
		}
	}
}

# The goods of the ticked right, parked on the winning location so the row can
# name them. Written per row rather than per candidate, like everything else
# here.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_store_right_goods = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:cloth }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:fine_cloth }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_3 value = goods:silk }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:cloth }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:fine_cloth }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:furniture }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:leather }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_3 value = goods:pottery }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:books }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:dyes }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_3 value = goods:paper }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:beer }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:liquor }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_3 value = goods:wine }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:jewelry }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_2
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 7 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:glass }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:masonry }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:naval_supplies }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:tar }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 9 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:cloth }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:dyes }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_3 value = goods:fine_cloth }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 10 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:tools }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_2
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 11 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:cannons }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:firearms }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_3 value = goods:weaponry }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 12 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:tools }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_2
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 13 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:naval_supplies }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:tar }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_3
	}
}

# Park the whole answer for one province, slot by slot.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_store_right_row = {
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_method value = var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 }
	bag_wtp_store_scratch = yes
	bag_wtp_slot_1_from_scratch = yes
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_method value = var:bag_wtp_r_method_2 }
	bag_wtp_store_scratch = yes
	bag_wtp_slot_2_from_scratch = yes
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_method value = var:bag_wtp_r_method_3 }
	bag_wtp_store_scratch = yes
	bag_wtp_slot_3_from_scratch = yes
	bag_wtp_store_right_goods = yes
	# What the row prints: the ranking number back in the unit it names, which is
	# what one level of the whole bundle would earn here.
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_value value = var:bag_wtp_r_total }
	change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_value divide = 100 }
}

# The ranking pass for a right. One row per province definition, as for a good,
# and the same fifty.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_fill_rows_right = {
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		order_by = bag_wtp_r_score
		max = 400
		check_range_bounds = no
		bag_wtp_store_right_row_if_worth_it = yes
	}
}

# Scope: location
bag_wtp_store_right_row_if_worth_it = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:bag_wtp_found < 50
			# Nothing in the bundle can be made here at all.
			var:bag_wtp_r_total > 0
			NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_row_taken }
		}
		province_definition = {
			every_location_in_province_definition = {
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_row_taken value = 1 }
				add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_row_taken_locations target = this }
			}
		}
		# The winners are parked before the province is judged: «is this ground
		# worth a row» is a question about the bonuses, and a bonus is not known
		# until the method that won it is.
		bag_wtp_store_right_row = yes
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_right_row_is_worth_it = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_found add = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rank value = global_var:bag_wtp_found }
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_ranked target = this }
		}
	}
}
